summary.plain: The CMD collaboration of the Budker Institute and partner institutes, which has built and run the CMD-1, CMD-2 and CMD-3 detectors at VEPP-2M and VEPP-2000 since 1979.
summary.technical: CMD Collaboration (BINP, Novosibirsk): history since 1979: CMD-1 at VEPP-2M 1979-1984, CMD-2 commissioning 1984-1992 and experiments 1992-2000, CMD-3 from 2000; membership list not retrieved.
